project_type: npm-workspaces monorepo (packages/*, apps/*, tools/*); building a new Next.js App Router + TypeScript web app at apps/web that consumes the existing NestJS API at apps/api
build_system: npm workspaces, Node >=20 (env is Node 24, npm 11.3), Windows/PowerShell. @lhd/shared is RAW ESM TypeScript exported from packages/shared/src/index.ts with NO build step, so Next must transpile it via next.config transpilePackages: ['@lhd/shared']. apps/web is already covered by the apps/* workspace glob; run npm install from the repo root after adding apps/web/package.json.
test_framework: Vitest + @testing-library/react + jsdom for apps/web (new). The API uses Jest. Root 'npm test' runs content:validate ONLY and must stay unchanged.
build_command: from apps/web: npm run build (Next build). It MUST complete 0 errors even when the API is not running.
test_command: from repo root: npm run test:web  (or from apps/web: npm test) -> vitest run
verification_instructions: Record all four in apps/web/VERIFICATION.md: (1) apps/web 'npm run build' 0 errors with API NOT running; (2) apps/web 'npm run lint' no errors; (3) 'npm run test:web' output shows pass; (4) RUNTIME HTML PROBE: build+start API (apps/api: 'npm run build' then 'node dist/main.js' on port 3001; wait for log 'Loaded 13 phase(s) of 13 catalog entries') and web (apps/web: 'npm run build' then 'npm run start' on port 3000) as BACKGROUND processes, then via a small probe .ps1 run with 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File' GET http://localhost:3000/ and http://localhost:3000/phases/phase-01 and assert the HTML contains real content (a phase title like 'Foundations', the 'never replaces'/'supports' principle text, and real phase-01 curriculum text such as a development-domain focus or an activity title). Then STOP both servers and delete the temp probe script. Prefer a short .ps1 over long inline PowerShell one-liners.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. apps/web/.next is build output (gitignore-equivalent, not committed).
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell. Background the dev/start servers for the runtime probe and STOP them (and remove temp .ps1 probe scripts) when done. API defaults to port 3001, web to 3000. API uses in-memory persistence when DATABASE_URL is unset (no DB needed). JWT dev secret default exists; /api/ai/ask, /api/progress/:userId are JWT-guarded.
contribution_requirements: Honour .kiro/steering/guiding-principles.md: teach HOW to think not what; platform STRENGTHENS and NEVER REPLACES parents/teachers/doctors/human relationships; health/safety/wellbeing questions route to humans. Content is data in packages/content and must NOT be duplicated in app code (fetch it from the API). Accessibility is a REQUIREMENT. Child-data protection is structural (no behavioural ad profiling, data minimisation). Verify with builds/tests before claiming done. Edit ONLY under apps/web plus ADDITIVE root package.json script entries (add dev:web and test:web; keep existing content:validate 'test' script). Do NOT modify packages/content, packages/shared, tools/, apps/api, apps/mobile.
key_patterns: Import types ONLY from '@lhd/shared' (e.g. import type { Phase, CatalogEntry, DevelopmentDomainKey, Source, DevelopmentDomain, YearPlan, Activity, GuidanceItem, Milestone, Project, AppFeature } from '@lhd/shared'); do not duplicate or diverge. All data fetching goes through lib/api.ts using fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' }) and returns a discriminated result ({ ok:true, data } | { ok:false, error }) — never throw, so next build cannot crash when the API is down; pages render an empty-state/retry instead. API base URL from process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL defaulting to 'http://localhost:3001/api'. Server components for data pages; client component only for the assistant form. Styling via CSS Modules + a globals.css theme with CSS custom properties — no network-dependent design deps. DevelopmentDomainKey values are kebab-case enums (15 of them) rendered via a lib/domain-labels.ts readable-label map with a fallback.
relevant_files: packages/shared/src/index.ts (types to import: Phase, CatalogEntry, DevelopmentDomainKey, DevelopmentDomain, YearPlan, Activity, GuidanceItem, Milestone, Project, AppFeature, Source, UserRole, ProgressRecord)
packages/shared/package.json (name @lhd/shared, type module, main src/index.ts, no build step)
packages/content/catalog.json (13 phase catalog entries; shape of CatalogEntry rendering)

packages/content/phases/phase-01/phase.json (exact rendered Phase shape incl. developmentDomains, yearPlans, activities{daily,weekly}, parentGuidance, milestones, safety, outcomes, projects, appFeatures, sources)
apps/api/src/ai/ai.controller.ts + ai.service.ts (POST /api/ai/ask -> { answer, routedToHuman, citations:[{phaseId,citation}] }, JWT-guarded)
apps/api/package.json (build: nest build; start: node dist/main.js)
package.json (root scripts; add dev:web and test:web additively)
directory_structure: apps/web/ to create: package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.mjs, .eslintrc.json, next-env.d.ts, vitest.config.ts, vitest.setup.ts, VERIFICATION.md; app/ (layout.tsx, globals.css, page.tsx, phases/page.tsx, phases/[idOrSlug]/page.tsx, assistant/page.tsx + page.module.css each); components/ (PhaseTimeline, PhaseCard, PrincipleBanner, EmptyState, PhaseView + .module.css); lib/ (api.ts, domain-labels.ts, __tests__/). Existing: apps/api (NestJS, do not modify), packages/shared (types, do not modify), packages/content (curriculum JSON, do not modify).
